description: Schedule 1 (Form 1040) 2025, line 8b: gambling winnings not attributable to a trade or business, from the closed Form W-2G box 1 family for the bounded class. Gambling winnings without a Form W-2G, business gambling and gambling losses are outside the class and stay refused by answer.

blocked.explain: Schedule 1 line 8b is blocked because the Form W-2G box 1 family is not confirmed closed, the gambling/other Schedule A declaration is not 'yes' while a Form W-2G is recorded, or the subtotal is unavailable.

closure_backed_zero.explain: A current derived finding publishes zero because the supporting source family is attested closed-empty under complete authority.

computed_zero.explain: A current derived finding publishes a computed zero under complete authority.

guard_inapplicable.explain: No value is published because a completeness or guard condition is not satisfied.

published_value.explain: A current derived finding publishes the gambling winnings on Schedule 1 line 8b from the closed Form W-2G box 1 family.

label: Gambling
